steps: Melt the sugar, water, butter, syrup and salt and cook until the sugar dissolves. Take off the heat and add the condensed milk.
Cook about 25 minutes, stirring constantly (it catches easily), until slightly grainy.
Off the heat, stir in the vanilla and pour into a greased tin.

resolvedChecks.note: The water quantity is partly illegible in the original ("! kop"); ½ cup is the usual amount.
resolvedChecks.resolution: ½ cup water kept (the usual amount).
